about: Hand-written probes for the deployed linguist GGUF (probe_linguist.py, judged through the Rust Core): hard cases the eval split does not single out. Each probe names the expected intent (null: no intent), the slots the Core should keep and its follow-ups (then). A slot with value null is not checked (free text whose English wording is open); any slot or follow-up the probe does not name fails it. Values are compared case-insensitively. Never used for training.
